description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map3_s04.harry_tell_me_whats_happening:
{wait 4.7}Harry, tell me
what's happening here?
Where is everybody?
strings.map3_s04.when_i_came_to_everyone:
{wait 3.2}When I came to,
everyone was gone.
strings.map3_s04.so_you_dont_know_anything:
{wait1 3.8}So you don't know
anything either.  Great.
strings.map3_s04.its_like_this_is_all:
{wait1 4.0}It's like this is
all some kind of bad dream.
strings.map3_s04.let_me_ask_you_have:
{wait1 3.6}Let me ask you, have you seen
a little girl around here?
strings.map3_s04.a_seven_year_old_girl:
{wait1 3.8}A seven-year-old girl?
What? She's your daughter?
strings.map3_s04.i_cant_say_that_i:
{wait1 4.8}I can't say that I have.
I was unconscious all this time.
strings.map3_s04.do_you_know_anything_about:
{wait1 3.8}Do you know anything about all
that weird stuff in the basement?
strings.map3_s04.no_why_is_there_something:
{wait1 3.8}No.  Why?
Is there something down there?
strings.map3_s04.you_dont_know_dont_you:
{wait1 2.7}You don't know?
Don't you work here?
strings.map3_s04.were_under_strict_orders_never:
{wait1 4.0}We're under strict orders never to
enter the basement storeroom.
strings.map3_s04.what_did_you_say_was: {wait1 2.0}What did you say was down there?
strings.map3_s04.there_is_a_plate_of:
There is a {color 2}Plate of [Queen]{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map3_s04.there_is_a_broken_vending:
There is a broken
vending machine.{end}
strings.map3_s04.nothing_useful_in_the_desk:
Nothing useful
in the desk drawer.{end}
strings.map3_s04.a_sound_is_heard_from:
A sound is heard
from beyond the door.{end}
